target.serverProfile: local API server; one worker; SQLite; ThreadPoolTaskRunner(max_workers=4)

acceptance.criterion: A native Pipeline Root Flow executes and returns a pipeline-level result.
acceptance.evidence: All four runs recorded one Root Flow Run in COMPLETED state.

acceptance.criterion: The Root Flow invokes at least two independently identifiable Stage Parent Flows.
acceptance.evidence: All four runs recorded two Stage Flow Runs, each correlated to the Root Flow and a native dispatch Task Run.

acceptance.criterion: Each Stage invokes at least two Steps through the public Step callable.
acceptance.evidence: All four runs recorded four Step Subflow Runs. Stage code submits invoke_step dispatch Tasks; each dispatch calls StepFacade.execute.

acceptance.criterion: Each Step is a native Prefect Subflow with an observable parent relationship.
acceptance.evidence: All four Step Flow Runs per run have a native parent_task_run_id and explicit owning Stage Flow Run correlation.

acceptance.criterion: At least two SPUs execute as Prefect Tasks inside each owning Step Subflow.
acceptance.evidence: Eight distinct SPU Task Runs per run; each Step result was assembled after its two SPU futures completed.

acceptance.criterion: The Stage does not bypass the Step boundary to call SPUs directly.
acceptance.evidence: The Stage invokes only StepFacade.execute through invoke_step; SPU callables are referenced only by _step_subworkflow.

acceptance.criterion: SPUExecutionResult and StepExecutionResult remain distinct and preserve the Step result fields.
acceptance.evidence: Contract-shaped SPUExecutionResult and StepExecutionResult values are separate; all four Step result categories are retained.

acceptance.criterion: GPWCF domain identities remain separate from Prefect native run identities.
acceptance.evidence: Trace records separate domain invocation identities, Flow Run IDs, Task Run IDs and parent correlation fields.

acceptance.criterion: Concurrent sibling Stage Parent Flow execution is deterministic in the selected local server profile.
acceptance.evidence: Sibling Stage Flow overlap occurred in 3/4 runs; the first run serialized the two child Flow executions. Dispatch Task submission alone does not guarantee concurrent child Flow execution.

acceptance.criterion: Sibling Step Subflow concurrency is repeatable and deterministic.
acceptance.evidence: No sibling Step Subflow pair overlapped in the four supported-profile runs (0/8 pairs).

acceptance.criterion: SPU Task fan-out/fan-in overlaps within every Step.
acceptance.evidence: Both SPU Tasks overlapped in all four Steps per run; 16/16 Step invocations across the four runs.

acceptance.criterion: Native result/state and exception boundaries are observable.
acceptance.evidence: Root Flow COMPLETED; SPU Tasks COMPLETED; isolated RuntimeError probe Task FAILED while the probe Flow completed after catching the exception. Domain result and operational state are stored separately.

acceptance.criterion: Real GPWCF production Stage/Step/SPU classes are bound to Prefect.
acceptance.evidence: The current GPWCF project has no executable production component classes; this phase uses contract-shaped fixtures only.

exitCriteriaAssessment.phaseDisposition: The native hierarchy structure and Step-internal SPU fan-out are qualified. Root sibling Stage Flow overlap occurred in 3/4 runs; sibling Step Subflows were serialized in 8/8 pairs. PHASE-01 is not a sibling-Flow concurrency sign-off; Generator branches that require parallel Stage execution remain blocked pending a deterministic Prefect-native execution profile.
